message.reasoning:
The user says "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker service, you need to start the Docker Desktop or Docker Engine service. On Windows, you can use `net start com.docker.service` or `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service` in PowerShell. Or if using Docker Desktop, you can start the application.

But the user might want to start Docker engine via command line. We can use `docker start` to start a container. But they said "start Docker on window using docker start." That seems ambiguous. They might want to start Docker service. So we can provide a command to start Docker service: `net start com.docker.service`. Or `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service`.

We have a tool to execute commands on Windows. We can call the function with command: `net start com.docker.service`. Let's do that.
